name: runner-sends-the-prompt-as-a-file
description: Incident 2026-11-11 bootstrap #8: runner-orca typed each job's multi-kilobyte prompt into the Claude terminal (`orca terminal send --text <prompt> --enter`), and the agent received only its tail, so every triage, spec, build and verify ran on a fragment. A runner adapter writes the full prompt to the worktree's prompt file (kept out of git) and types only harness-claude's one-line pointer to it.
message: Never type the job's prompt into a terminal: write job.harness.prompt to PROMPT_FILE in the worktree and send PROMPT_POINTER (one short line). See .factory/checks/runner-adapters.md and incident 2026-11-11 #8.
